sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XVI, List of Answers on Terminology 48

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XVI, List of Answers on Terminology 48:1
items.html: Tifferet is the Bina of the body, and it has ten Sefirot, and therefore it divides into three thirds: HBD HGT NHYM. Thus the upper third of Tifferet is the discernment of its HBD, and it is the discernment of the GAR of the Bina of the body. (Part 1, Page 888, Sub Header, "and he raised").
